observations: Photo 0: a gold-coloured slim games console held in a hand, top lid with the PlayStation logo, flat front with two shallow indented bands and a small PS mark at the front right corner; the shape is that of a PS4 Slim.
Photo 0: outer shell looks clean, no visible scratches or dents at this resolution.
Photo 0: shot in a shop: a second gold console and a stack of black consoles sit behind it, and an overlaid shop watermark reads 'HYMAN GADGETS'.
Photo 0: no controller, cables, accessories, box or receipt are shown.
Photo 0: the console is not powered; no screen, storage size or serial label is visible.
Photo 0: the back, ports and the warranty seal area are not shown.

read_from: photo 0 PlayStation logo on the lid
photo 0 PS4 Slim body shape and front PS mark

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a gold PS4 Slim body with the PlayStation logo; the exact edition and storage size are not shown.
Photo 0 shows a clean top and front; the back and underside are not shown.

claims.claim: Comes with controller, original pads and other accessories
claims.evidence: No controller or accessory appears in photo 0.
The warranty seal and screw heads on the back are not shown.
Heat behaviour cannot be shown in a still; a long play clip would only reduce the doubt.
Back ports and front USB ports are not shown, and nothing is plugged in.
No receipt is shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Console may not power on, read discs, or reach the home screen.
risks.proof: Clip of the console powering on, inserting and reading a disc, and opening Settings > System > System Information, with the seller's handwritten code in shot.

risks.risk: Storage may be the smaller size, or the drive may have been swapped.
risks.proof: Screenshot or screen photo of Settings > Storage showing total capacity, plus the model label on the back.

risks.risk: Controllers and accessories may be missing or faulty.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out together, and a clip of each controller working on screen.
risks.if_unproven: as console only, no controller or cables

risks.risk: Console banned from the online network or locked to another account.
risks.proof: Clip of the console signing in to the PlayStation Network and opening the store.

risks.risk: Shop photo of stock; the unit sold may not be the one pictured, or may be opened or repaired.
risks.proof: Photo of the back of the exact console showing the serial label and the intact warranty seal, with a handwritten note of today's date.

proof_requests: Clip of the console powered on, showing System Information and Storage on the screen, with a handwritten code in shot.
Photo of the back showing the model and serial label and the warranty seal.
Photo of all items included: controllers, cables, accessories and the receipt.
Clip of each controller working and a disc being read.
Clip of a PlayStation Network sign-in.
response.reason: The PlayStation logo and slim body in photo 0 identify a gold PS4 Slim, so it can be priced at its worst case: console only, smaller storage, not working, opened. Power-on clips and photos of the included pads and receipt would raise it.
